description: This file defines an Android activity class 'GLES20Activity' that demonstrates checking for OpenGL ES 2.0 support at runtime and sets up the appropriate renderer for a GLSurfaceView.

classes.name: GLES20Activity
classes.description: An Android activity that detects OpenGL ES 2.0 support and sets up corresponding rendering options.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView, checks for OpenGL ES 2.0 support, and sets the appropriate renderer.

methods.name: detectOpenGLES20
methods.description: Checks if the device supports OpenGL ES 2.0.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume and resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause and pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering.
